territories.name: Madagascar
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and a State outside it is a third country for every rule the Directive carries. Madagascar levies a value-added tax of its own under the Code des impôts: article 06.01.12 sets the normal rate at twenty percent, a reduced rate of five percent for butane gas and a zero rate for exports, and article 06.01.16 has the taxpayer file the return and pay the tax by the fifteenth of the month that follows each month.
